title: 第119章 唐敬的天，塌了！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 没有抄袭只是借用？听到唐画的话，现场所有人都呆住了。他们原本还以为唐画会争辩下，会摆开阵仗和福王大战一场，证明抄袭的不是他，是唐逸。毕竟三元及第的状元，他真敢信誓旦旦摆开擂台，还是会有人相信他的。却没想到，他竟然直接承认抄袭了。借用不是抄袭吗？科举考试策论用典无可厚非，但诗词也能借用这是什么神仙操作？“妈的，竟然是真的，唐画真的抄袭了唐逸的诗词！”“草，什么三元及第的状元，垃圾，废物，蠢货，猪狗不如的东西！”“亏老子还这么相信他，原来他就是个伪君子，无耻贼子，该死！”“……”沉寂了一瞬，整个鹿鸣湖瞬间炸了。所有人盯着台上的唐画，谩骂嘲讽声宛若海浪一般席卷全场。群情激愤，个个怒火中烧，恨不得冲上台，将唐画给当场撕了。刚才，他们相信唐画的话，各种看不上唐逸，却没想到最后小丑竟然是唐画，是他们自己！而刘温，赵柯等一众大臣，得到唐画肯定的答案，也全都跳脚了。“什么？竟然真的是抄袭的！”“他怎么敢的？他怎么敢？他丢的不是唐家的脸，他是将我们当傻子来耍。”“他耍的不只是我们，更是陛下，是大炎文坛，是大炎朝廷！”“无耻畜生！老夫定不与你干休！”“……”刘温已经跳了起来，怒火中烧，满脸青紫。赵柯以及一众大臣，也都瞠目结舌，目瞪口呆。今日风很大，特别是风过鹿鸣湖，带来阵阵凉意……然而，此时凉意却浇不灭他们身上的怒火。想到当日殿试上，唐画是何等的意气风发，一首《劝谏诗》震撼全场，被他们誉为文坛新星，是他们文官子弟中的佼佼者，领头羊。皇帝有小诗仙，他们有唐画。唐画一出，必定能战胜小诗仙，将小诗仙踩在脚下。却没想到，特妈的唐画的成名作，竟然出自小诗仙之手。出自小诗仙之手就罢了，他竟然还敢拿到殿试上炫耀，敢带着他们一群大臣，在殿试上将皇帝逼得狼狈不堪。最后，还得了个状元之位……那时，他们是何等的狂喜狂笑狂傲！但现在，他们只觉得脸上被噼里啪啦甩巴掌，恨不得挖个坑，将自己给埋了。该死的唐画狗东西，你把我们给坑惨了啊！“不……不可能，为什么？为什么会这样？”唐敬此时已经跌坐在椅子上，就像是浑身的精气神在这一瞬间给抽干了。他脸色呆滞，眼神涣散，仿佛心底的自信和信念在这一瞬间崩塌了。唐画，那是他倾尽所有心血培养的唐家接班人。是他唐家最有出息的儿子。琴棋书画样样精通，诗词歌赋样样在行，温文尔雅，谦谦君子，提起他整个京都谁不竖起大拇指，称一声好男儿当如是？那是他的骄傲，是唐家的骄傲。三元及第，更是唐家祖宗十八代的骄傲！结果，现在却告诉他，这一切都是假的。他引以为傲的儿子，不过是个卑劣的小人，是个喜欢玩弄人心的伪君子。而他最瞧不上，最看不上的嫡子，才是真正的学富五车，才是真正的才华横溢。“不，不是这样的，不应该是这样的……”唐敬颤抖呢喃，只觉得脑袋上天雷滚滚，往他无情碾压而来。他的天，塌了！此时，同样感觉天塌了的，还有姜云娜！她踉跄退了六七步，盯着台上被福王逼得狼狈后退的唐画，脸色苍白得吓人。“抄袭……怎么可能？怎么可能抄袭？”“画哥哥你不是文采风流吗？画哥哥你不是说唐逸在你面前，连根发丝都比不上吗？”“既然他在你面前屁都不算，你抄袭他算什么？！”姜云娜不敢相信这是真的，眼泪簌簌而落，我见优伶。唐画在他眼中，那是个完美无瑕的男人，是个没有半点缺陷的男人。可现在这个完美的男人，却在全场数百人的面前，上演了一出无耻至极的大戏。三元及第的状元是假的，才华横溢是假的，连参加殿试夺魁的诗词，都是假的。更让她难以接受的，唐画抄袭的还是唐逸的诗。而唐逸，在她眼中不过是个十足十的废物……不，唐逸是废物，这个理论，似乎一直都是唐画告诉她的。想到这里，姜云娜的心猛地一跳，浑身又冷了几分。难道，这一切……都是唐画在故意引导，让自己误会唐逸的吗？姜云娜不愿意去怀疑唐画，可这个念头刚跳出来，便让她抑制不住多想，让她感到恐惧和彷徨！如此玩弄和利用人心，如此卑鄙无耻下作……这竟然是她喜欢的人？！而站在前方的颜霜玉，此时整个人也傻了！“不可能，画儿那么优秀，他怎么可能抄袭那废物的诗词。”她有些歇斯底里地怒吼，但她的声音很快就被全场的声浪给吞噬了。她不敢相信这是真的！为了唐画的殿试，她的确重金请了人帮唐画写了诗词，可都被唐画拒绝了。当时唐画信誓旦旦保证，他能写出更好的诗词。这更好的诗词，就是抄袭唐逸那废物的吗？“哥，你疯了？！”就连一直对唐画唯首是瞻的唐浩，这时都瞪大眼睛，一副见了鬼的表情。他们兄弟俩平时喜欢抢夺唐逸的东西，唐逸有的他们会想方设法抢过来。可那是摸得着看得见的东西，而且是在唐家内部，想怎么玩还不是他们说了算？但诗词这种东西，那就不是唐家内部的事了，你偷他的诗词干嘛啊！当然，让唐浩绝望的不是这个，让唐浩绝望的是唐画今日输了，那他们就惨了啊！他们现在还差地下钱庄十万两银子，还想等唐画今日夺魁陛下赐婚，好好的从那些世家大族手中大赚一笔。现在，全泡汤了！唐画败了，唐家现在一穷二白，他们拿什么还钱？不，不止是钱。还有他们唐家的一切！盗诗殿试，舞弊之耻，欺君大罪啊！完了，唐家要完了！唐浩双腿一热，一股液体顺着裤裆直接淌了下来……“嘶，一波三折，这大炎朝廷可真有意思。”秦钰抱着双手，目光鄙夷盯着唐画。还以为唐画和唐逸会是大炎文坛的双子星，却没想到到最后，真正的文坛之星只有唐逸一个人啊！宇文封睨着唐画，眼中也满是不屑。连和对手面对面决死战的勇气都没有，算什么男人。“哼，早和你们说过了，我哥哥很厉害，你们还不信。”唐音皱了皱鼻，抱着手酷酷冷哼：“现在，都知道了吧？”小脸上满是得意和傲娇。
content_en: No plagiarism, just borrowing?After hearing Tang Hua's words, everyone at the scene was stunned.They originally thought that Tang Hua would argue and start a battle with King Fu to prove that it was not him who plagiarized, but Tang Yi.After all, if he is the number one pick in the third place, if he really dares to declare his promise and enter the arena, some people will still believe him.Unexpectedly, he directly admitted to plagiarism.Is borrowing not plagiarism?There is nothing wrong with using allusions in imperial examination policy, but poems can also use allusions. What kind of magical operation is this?"Damn it, it's true. Tang Hua really plagiarized Tang Yi's poems!" "Fuck, what kind of third-level champion, trash, waste, idiot, something worse than a pig or a dog!" "It's a shame I still believe in him, it turns out he is a hypocrite, a shameless thief, damn it!" "..." After a moment of silence, the entire Luming Lake exploded in an instant.Everyone stared at the Tang painting on the stage, and the sound of abuse and ridicule swept through the audience like a wave of waves.The crowd was furious, and everyone was so angry that they wanted to rush to the stage and tear up the Tang paintings on the spot.Just now, they believed Tang Hua's words and looked down on Tang Yi, but they didn't expect that the clown in the end turned out to be Tang Hua and themselves!When Liu Wen, Zhao Ke and other ministers received Tang Hua's affirmative answer, they all jumped."What? It's really plagiarism!" "How dare he? How dare he? He didn't disgrace the Tang family, he treated us as fools." "He was not just fooling us, but also His Majesty, the Great Yan literary world, and the Great Yan court!" "Shameless beast! I will never let you go!" "..." Liu Wen had jumped up, furious, and his face was purple.Zhao Ke and all the ministers were also dumbfounded.The wind was very strong today, especially the wind passing through Luming Lake, which brought bursts of coolness... However, the coolness could not extinguish their anger at this time.Thinking of how high-spirited Tang Hua was in the palace examination that day, his "Poetry of Admonition" shocked the audience. He was hailed by them as a new star in the literary world, the best and the leader among their civil servants.The emperor had little poets, and they had Tang paintings.As soon as Tang Hua comes out, he will definitely defeat the little poetry fairy and trample him under his feet.But I didn't expect that Te Ma's famous Tang painting was actually written by the little poetry fairy.It was just the work of a little poetry fairy, but he actually dared to show off in the palace examination. He dared to lead a group of ministers and forced the emperor into a state of embarrassment in the palace examination.Finally, they won the top spot... At that time, they were so ecstatic, laughing and arrogant!But now, they just feel like they were slapped in the face, and they want to dig a hole and bury themselves.Damn Tang Hua, you screwed us up!"No...impossible, why? Why is this happening?" Tang Jing had already fallen down on the chair, as if all the energy in his body had been drained at this moment.His face was dull and his eyes were unfocused, as if the self-confidence and belief in his heart collapsed at this moment.Tang Hua was the successor of the Tang family that he devoted all his efforts to training.He is the most promising son of his Tang family.He is proficient in all kinds of music, chess, calligraphy and painting, and is good at all kinds of poetry, poetry and poetry. He is gentle and elegant, and he is a humble gentleman. Who in the capital wouldn't give him a thumbs up and call him a good man?That was his pride, the pride of the Tang family.The third Yuan Dynasty is the pride of the eighteen generations of the Tang family!As a result, he is now told that all this is false.His proud son is nothing but a despicable villain and a hypocrite who likes to play with people's hearts.And the legitimate son who he despises the most and despises the most is the real scholar and rich man, the real talent."No, it's not like this, it shouldn't be like this..." Tang Jing trembled and murmured, feeling like thunder was rolling over his head, crushing him mercilessly.His sky has fallen!At this time, Jiang Yunna also felt that the sky was falling!She staggered back six or seven steps and stared at Tang Hua on the stage who was forced to retreat in embarrassment by King Fu. Her face was frighteningly pale."Plagiarism... how is it possible? How is it possible to plagiarize?" "Brother Hua, aren't you a man of literary talent? Brother Hua, didn't you say that Tang Yi can't compare to a hair in front of you?" "Since he is nothing in front of you, what does it mean if you plagiarize him?!" Jiang Yunna couldn't believe this was true, and tears fell down, I saw the actor.In his eyes, Tang Hua was a flawless man, a man without any flaws.But now this perfect man performed a shameless show in front of hundreds of people in the audience.The number one scholar in three yuan is fake, the talent is fake, and even the poems he wrote to win the first prize in the imperial examination are fake.What made it even more difficult for her to accept was that the Tang paintings plagiarized Tang Yi's poems.And Tang Yi, in her eyes, is just a complete waste... No, Tang Yi is a waste. This theory seems to have been told to her by Tang Hua all along.Thinking of this, Jiang Yunna's heart skipped a beat, and her whole body became a little colder.Could it be that all of this... was Tang Hua deliberately guiding him to misunderstand Tang Yi?Jiang Yunna didn't want to doubt Tang Hua, but as soon as the idea popped up, she couldn't help but think about it, making her feel scared and hesitant!To play with and take advantage of people's hearts in such a despicable and shameless manner... This is actually the person she likes?!And Yan Shuangyu, who was standing in front, was also stunned!"Impossible, Hua'er is so good, how could he plagiarize that useless poem?" She roared hysterically, but her voice was quickly swallowed up by the sound of the entire audience.She couldn't believe this was true!For Tang Hua's imperial examination, she did pay a lot of money to hire people to write poems for Tang Hua, but they were all rejected by Tang Hua.At that time, Tang Hua vowed that he could write better poems.Are these better poems copied from that trash Tang Yi?"Brother, are you crazy?!" Even Tang Hao, who had always looked up to Tang Hua, his eyes widened as if he had seen a ghost.The two brothers usually like to snatch Tang Yi's things, and they will try their best to snatch Tang Yi's things.But it was something tangible and visible, and it was within the Tang family. It wasn't them who had the final say on how they wanted to play?But poetry is not an internal matter of the Tang family. Why are you stealing his poetry?Of course, this is not what makes Tang Hao despair. What makes Tang Hao despair is that if Tang Hua loses today, then they will be miserable!They are still short of 100,000 taels of silver from underground banks. They also want to wait for Tang Hua to win the first prize today and His Majesty will grant him a marriage, so that they can make a lot of money from those wealthy families.Now, it's all in vain!Tang Hua was defeated and the Tang family was now destitute. What could they use to pay back the money?
title_en: Chapter 119 Tang Jing’s sky has collapsed!
